Discover BIM talent. Intelligently.

BIM professionals across architecture, structure, MEP, infrastructure, BIM management and CAD drafting, each one technically assessed before you see a profile.

How the talent pool works

Assessed first, shown second.

Every professional in the ENGISOFT talent pool is assessed on experience, software, technical knowledge and a practical BIM task before a profile is shared.

Profiles are anonymised. You see competencies, assessment results and verification dates; personal details are shared only when you decide to interview.
